metric: source automated-quality score, aggregated as the mean of present rankingSurfaces values

runs.articleTitle: Autogenerate Show Notes with Whisper-cpp, Llama-cpp, and Node-js

tiers.label: Tier 2
tiers.description: Middle quality-cost tercile; no models fall in this tier for this group size.

tiers.label: Tier 3
tiers.description: Lower quality-cost tercile; no models fall in this tier for this group size.

rankingPolicy.price: mean monetary cost in USD ascending; local providers at zero; then automated quality descending, processing time ascending, providerKey ascending; missing values sort last
rankingPolicy.speed: mean processing time ascending; then automated quality descending, providerKey ascending; missing values sort last
rankingPolicy.automatedQuality: mean source rankingSurfaces automatedQuality value descending; then processing time ascending, providerKey ascending; missing values sort last
rankingPolicy.weightedComposite: per-run per-group min-max 0-100 subscores (Q higher-better; S/C lower-better; identical min/max => 100), averaged across covered runs; composite = w_q*Q + w_s*S + w_c*C
rankingPolicy.missingData: provider missing a value in a run is excluded from that run's normalization pool for that dimension; a dimension missing in all covered runs scores 0 and is listed in missingDimensions

dimensions.quality: source automatedQuality value; higher is better
dimensions.cost: costCents; lower is better; local monetary cost is zero

normalization.range: min-max 0-100; identical present min/max values receive 100
normalization.aggregation: mean of each provider's present per-run subscores

notes: Each provider is aggregated by providerKey within its source group; present-value means do not impute missing rows or metrics.
Local and service providers are never normalized, ranked, or tiered together; local monetary cost remains zero.
No human-quality ranking is emitted because explicit human-quality rows are absent from the current source reports.
Weighted composite rankings and quality-cost tercile tiers are precomputed per group; the HTML performs no runtime metric or composite calculation.
